Container.Name: My-Cloud
Container.Overview: My Cloud is a lightweight file sharing platform in the spirit of Nextcloud/ownCloud, but with no external database. Multi-user accounts, a web file browser with previews, resumable uploads, public share links with passwords and expiry, a trash bin, quotas, WebDAV, and optional two-factor authentication. User files stay as ordinary files on your array - browse them with any other tool, back them up with rsync, nothing is locked inside a database blob.
Container.Description: Lightweight file sharing with plain files on disk. On first launch, open the WebUI to create your admin account. User files are stored under the Data path at users/<username>/files, so they stay browseable from any Unraid share tool. Accounts and share links live in a small SQLite database in the Config path; back that directory up as well, since it holds secret.key (the encryption root for 2FA secrets and share passwords).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, the SQLite database, and secret.key. Back this up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns created files (Unraid default: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns created files (Unraid default: 100 = users)
